item.title: Warrant Arrest By Troopers
item.description: A Chilicothe man was arrested by State Troopers in Livingston County on a warrant for alleged DUI. Thirty-year-old Cole A. Nichols of Chillicothe was arrested just after 7:00 pm and held pending the posting of bond.

item.title: Chillicothe Fire Protection District Meeting
item.description: The Chillicothe Fire Protection District #1 of Livingston County met Tuesday evening. The board approved the budget that includes revenues of about $156,000. Expenditures are split, with 50% to the City of Chillicothe, 25% into the truck replacement fund, and 25% for organization expenses. The board rejected bids for the sale of a surplus pumper […]

item.title: Driver Exam Stations To Close For State Holidays
item.description: Driver examination stations in Missouri will be closed for two holidays this month. The Missouri Highway Patrol says the closures include: Thursday, February 12th, for President Lincoln’s Birthday. Monday, February 16th, for President Washington’s Birthday.

item.title: Lawrence “Joe” Joseph Saale, Jr.
item.description: Lawrence “Joe” Joseph Saale, Jr., age 81, a Chillicothe, Missouri resident, passed away on Wednesday, February 4, 2026 at Morningside Center, Chillicothe, Missouri. Joe was born the fourth child of eleven, to Lawrence Joseph and Frances Helen (Garber) Saale, on April 10, 1944 in Chillicothe, Missouri. He was a 1962 graduate of Chillicothe High School. […]
